If the two live manifest edits cannot coexist with frozen-byte obligations, stop and explain that precise conflict; do not broaden scope.
3. Run taplo lint and taplo format --check, the relevant pc-ci checks where available, and focused existing harness/integrity checks needed to establish that formatting did not alter semantics or frozen evidence. Preserve R1 acceptance, 120 measured + 9 untimed/oracle programme, warm 20+20 unadmitted, and pending separately authorised i9 CPU/corpus preflight. No measurements or workstation commands.
4. Append only the justified correction to the PR and report its exact full head. Account for current master/#375 compatibility without importing unrelated changes or rewriting history. Normal CI caused by a genuine fix is the next validation; read both Actions and legacy statuses at the corrected head. No manual rerun of the old job, full-workflow retry, empty commit, gate waiver or merge.
5. Keep the cancelled macOS x86_64 job 131361540210 separate. The handoff supplies acquisition/internal-server-error evidence, but four reported annotations versus five copied lines and x86_64 versus arm64 notices remain unresolved. Preserve those discrepancies; do not map notices or assert a final Class B diagnosis without all CI-INCIDENTS prerequisites. It ran no project steps and is not a pass.
